We need to analyze method getQuestion(): it accesses sections[Section.QUESTION]; if null or empty returns null; else returns l.get(0). Potential exception scenarios: IndexOutOfBounds? Not because we check isEmpty. NullPointer? If sections array itself is null, or sections[Section.QUESTION] is null (handled). But if sections array is null, then sections[Section.QUESTION] throws NPE. Also if Section.QUESTION index out of bounds (if sections length less than Section.QUESTION+1). Section constants likely defined elsewhere; but could be out of range. Also if list contains null at index 0, l.get(0) returns null (no exception). So exception scenarios: NullPointerException due to sections being null; ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException due to sections length insufficient; maybe ClassCastException if sections array not of List<Record>[]? That's compile-time. Also potential ConcurrentModification? Not.

Thus need test cases for those exception scenarios not covered.

Existing tests cover null section entry, empty list, etc. Not covering sections array null or insufficient length.
